svg.desc: Mirrors App/ProjectDetailView.swift versionRow — see blended-clip-row.default.wide.svg for the base mirror note. A time-sliced VIDEO export (BlendKind.video, blend.timeSlice != nil): the title comes from TimeSliceRecipe.displayName (Kit/Sources/LetsLapseKit/TimeSlice.swift:164) rather than "Blended clip N" — the real, technical form ("timeslice-‹axis›-‹edge›-segs_N-lag_N"), decided 2026-08-28. Added 2026-09-07 for the Part 2 filter mockup: the wide row also needs a title-column clip here, unlike the other three states, because this real string genuinely overflows even the 361pt card (255pt available) — the app's own .lineLimit(1) would truncate it too.
